sources: Esri World Imagery (leaf-off) with the UseDirect site points

values.note: Park's own 2026 and 2027 rate sheets (identical): on-season (April 15-October 31) / off-season (November 1-April 14) basic $15 / $14, electric 30A $27 / $23, electric 50A $29 / $25, sewer/electric/water 50A $35 / $29 (water depends on weather), family basic $28 / $26, family electric 50A $52 / $46. Rates include sales tax; a family site (two pads) takes one reservation fee.

fees.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/02/weston-bend-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('ON-SEASON (April 15 through Oct. 31)', 'OFF-SEASON (Nov. 1 through April 14)', 'Basic $15 $14', 'Electric - 30 AMP $27 $23', 'Electric - 50 AMP $29 $25', 'Family/Basic $28 $26', 'Family/Electric 50 AMP $52 $46', '*Sewer/Electric/Water 50 AMP $35 $29') + weston-bend-2026-camping-fees.pdf (same figures), read 2026-11-07. Basic sites 3 and 26 are 62-ft pads, so a 23-ft rig fits the basic base.

values.note: $2 a night off year-round for seniors 65+, persons with disabilities, military and veterans; ask at payment, with proof.

discounts.source: https://mostateparks.com/sites/g/files/zuston361/files/media/pdf/2026/02/weston-bend-camping-fees-2027.pdf ('A $2 PER NIGHT CAMPING DISCOUNT is available year-round for senior citizens (65 years and older), persons with disabilities, military and veterans'), read 2026-11-07

hookups.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/weston-bend-state-park/weston-bend-state-park/camping (Types of Sites 'Basic, Electric*, Family*, Sewer/Electric/Water*'; '* 50-amp electric sites available') + UseDirect grid (sites 36-50 'Sewer/Electric/Water 50 amp'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: 48 campsites on the booking grid: 2 basic, 1 family basic, 21 electric 30A, 8 electric 50A, 1 family electric 50A, 15 sewer/electric/water 50A. Pads 40-74 ft except pull-through 39 (128 ft); pull-throughs at 11 and 39.

sites.source: https://msprdr.usedirect.com/MSPRDR/rdr/search/grid PlaceId 98, facility 843 'Campground' (unit types, VehicleLength) + /search/details per unit ('Pull-In-Type: Pull-Through' on 11 and 39), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Showers and modern restrooms April 15-October 31; off-season potable water at the fill hydrant by the dump station.

facilities.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/weston-bend-state-park/weston-bend-state-park/camping (amenity symbols: running water, frost-free water, restroom, shower, vault toilet, dump station; 'Showers/Water Available Apr 15-Oct 31'; 'During the off-season (Nov. 1 through April 14), potable water is available from the fresh water fill hydrant at the dump station'), read 2026-11-07

booking.source: https://mostateparks.com/park/weston-bend-state-park/weston-bend-state-park/camping ('reserve your Missouri State Parks campsite up to 12 months in advance'; table, Reservations 'Apr 15-Oct 31'; 'The campground is fully reservable during the on-season. Reservable sites may be available on a walk-up registration basis if the site is not reserved'; 'Camping is limited to any 15 days within a 30-consecutive-day period'), read 2026-11-07

note: A single wooded campground on the upland near Weston; the Missouri River views are from the park's trails and overlook, not from the sites. Extra vehicles park only at the showerhouse lot - there is no overflow. The park gate closes at 9 p.m. in season and 6 p.m. off-season. --Claude
